title: Cobblemon but lowkey better
description: This pack adds a new experience to cobblemon that adds exciting items, resources, and textures to the base 1.7.1 cobblemon
body:
This project is an add-on for Cobblemon that expands gameplay by introducing more fun and varied experiences for players. The mod focuses on enhancing exploration, interaction, and progression within the Cobblemon experience without changing its core mechanics.

Players can expect additional content and features designed to make playing Cobblemon feel more engaging and dynamic, whether playing solo or in multiplayer worlds. The goal of this project is to build on Cobblemon’s existing systems in a way that feels natural, balanced, and enjoyable.

This mod requires Cobblemon to function and is intended for players who want more variety and replay value in their Cobblemon gameplay.
